subnets.title: Subnets
subnets.description: Maintain IPv4 / IPv6 segments, address pools and DHCP delivery parameters per organization; changes sync to Kea automatically.
subnets.scopeHint: Counts include child organizations; click a node to drill down

org.title: Organizations
org.emptyNoneDesc: Click Manage in the top right to create an organization node

grid.name: Subnet
grid.empty: No subnets in this organization. Click New in the top right to add one.
grid.confirmDeleteDesc: This cannot be undone; it fails while leases or reservations still reference it.

lease6.note: Live projection from Kea (lease_cmds); it can differ by seconds from the ledger online counts above. PD delegations are counted per IA_PD prefix.
lease6.empty: Kea has not returned any DHCPv6 leases yet

form.poolPair: A pool requires both start and end (leave both empty to skip the pool; the subnet then allocates no dynamic addresses)
form.noPool: No address pool: this subnet allocates no dynamic addresses (reservations/static bindings only)

options.title: Options & Classes
options.description: Maintain global DHCP option-data and client-classes matching rules; changes are delivered to Kea atomically.

stat.optEnabledHint: {n} disabled and left out of the Kea config

options.changesHint: Changes are delivered to Kea atomically via config-set
options.disabledHint: Disabled options are not written to the Kea config
options.optEmpty: No standard options yet. Click Add option to create one.
options.clsEmpty: No class rules yet. Click Add class to create one.
options.clsHint: The class name is the Kea reference key and cannot be changed after creation
options.clsExtraHint: client-classes · matching test delivers the class options

modal.quickFillPlaceholder: Selecting one fills in the option code and Kea name
modal.hint: Saved changes are delivered to Kea atomically via config-set; disabled options are not written to the config file.

classModal.title: Class rules
classModal.hint: Clients matching test receive the option-data of this class; the class name is the Kea reference key and cannot be changed.
classModal.emptyDesc: Click Add option to configure the option-data that matching clients of this class will receive

messages.optRequired: Option name and value are required
messages.clsOptRequired: Name and value are required for options inside a class

dualstack.title: Dual-stack
dualstack.description: Configure bindings between IPv4 pools and IPv6 prefixes, maintain MAC↔DUID identities and resolve unresolved conflicts.
dualstack.templateExtra: The daemon picks a template by the longest matching IPv4 lease prefix
dualstack.encodingHint: Type A packs into the last 32 bits · Type B mirrors decimal digits
dualstack.templateEmpty: No binding templates yet. Click New template in the top right to create one.
dualstack.identityEmpty: No mappings yet; create them manually while resolving conflicts or let the matching scheme learn them
dualstack.reasonExtra: Pick a v4 MAC for the conflict to create a mapping
dualstack.conflictEmpty: No unresolved conflicts; dual-stack linkage is healthy

schemeHint.auto: Linked automatically in the priority chain admin→option79→client-id→duid-llt→hostname
schemeHint.option79: Requires RFC6939 on the relay and the kea hook loaded
schemeHint.client-id: Requires the client to send an RFC4361 client-id (i.e. DUID) in DHCPv4
schemeHint.duid-llt: Extract the MAC embedded in DUID-LLT
schemeHint.hostname: Reverse-lookup v4 leases by hostname; ambiguous names go to the conflict list
schemeHint.admin: Only manual mappings count; missing mappings go to the conflict list

dualstack.exprHex32Suffix: (Type A · v4 packed into the last 32 bits, compact)

disableHint.noMac: This conflict has no MAC signal, so there are no candidates
disableHint.pinned: The pinned scheme fell back and no candidate MAC exists; add signal on the v4 side first

messages.required: Name, IPv4 segment and IPv6 prefix are all required
messages.graceRange: The grace period must be between 0 and 720 hours

modal.title: Dual-stack binding template
modal.name: Template name
modal.dnsSyncOn: Sync A/AAAA records during dual-stack linkage
modal.dnsSyncOff: Generate addresses only, do not write DNS

mappingModal.title: Set MAC↔DUID mapping
mappingModal.notePlaceholder: Optional; explain the basis for manual confirmation
mappingModal.hint: Once created, the endpoint is removed from the conflict list and takes part in subsequent dual-stack linkage.

leases.title: Leases
leases.description: Inspect Kea leases in real time and extend, rebind or release them; changes hit the DHCP service directly, no restart needed.
leases.confirmReleaseDesc: Client {mac} will request an address again.
leases.extendHint: Only the running Kea lease is changed; the server policy applies at the client's next renewal.
leases.rebindHint: Rebinding only changes who owns the existing lease; for a permanent pin use Reservations & Bindings to create a host reservation.

messages.lifetimeMin: The lease lifetime must be at least 60 seconds
messages.macFormat: The MAC format must be aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff

reservations.title: Reservations & Bindings
reservations.description: Maintain reserved addresses and static bindings in bulk; submissions are transactional: if any row fails, everything rolls back.
reservations.searchPlaceholder: Fuzzy search by IP / MAC / hostname (case-insensitive)
reservations.confirmReleaseStatic: The static binding (MAC {mac}) will be deleted and the address returns to the dynamic pool. Online leases are unaffected.
reservations.confirmReleaseReserved: The reservation (freeze) will be cancelled and the address returns to the dynamic pool.
reservations.editMacTitle: Edit MAC · {address} (no subnet info, MAC only)
reservations.noSubnetHint: No subnet info; only the MAC can be changed
reservations.editHint: Changing the address releases the old one and binds again at the new address; the old address returns to the dynamic pool.

messages.needAddress: At least one row is required and every address is mandatory
messages.macInvalidLine: Invalid MAC on line {line} (C4-3D-1A-07-EB-2B / C43D1A07EB2B / colon separated, any case)
messages.rolledBack: Some rows failed; everything was rolled back
messages.macInvalid: Invalid MAC (C4-3D-1A-07-EB-2B / C43D1A07EB2B / colon separated, any case)
messages.needSubnetForAddress: This record lacks subnet info; only the MAC can be changed

utilization.title: Utilization
utilization.description: Every 5 minutes each IPv4 subnet pool's used addresses (bindings/reservations) are sampled and kept for 90 days; above 85% triggers the alert metric.
utilization.detailHint: Utilization = bound/reserved addresses in the pool ÷ pool capacity; static addresses outside the pool are excluded.
